command getGuestAuth
	global gProject, gProjectName	 
	local tProject,tAuthStatus
	//put "";breakpoint
	if there is a stack "Appli" then
		put gProject into tProject
	else if there is a stack "Appli_Player" then
		put gProjectName into tProject
	end if
	
	cdb_unloadTable "*"
	 get cdb_auth("appliguest@appli.io","gXZKW#ByKc%!Q!WgxZmJ","user",tProject)
	 if not cdb_result() then
		 put cdb_authStatus() into tAuthStatus
		 if tAuthStatus["cloud"] is false and tAuthStatus["local"] then
			 cdb_loadTable "*"
		 end if
		put True into guestAuthFailed
	 else
		 get cdb_sdk(tProject)
		 cdb_loadTable "*"
		put False into guestAuthFailed
	 end if
end getGuestAuth
